issues.problem: explain claimed に is 'the only choice' for a chance encounter; 偶然友達と会った is also natural native usage
issues.action: Softened to 'the natural choice for running into someone or going to see them, above all a superior'

issues.problem: pattern '[place / person] に 偶然 会う' implies 駅に会う, which is ungrammatical
issues.action: Changed to '[person] に 偶然 会う'

issues.problem: mistake 十時までに寝ていました is not clearly wrong: it can mean 'was (already) asleep by ten'
issues.action: Replaced with 友達を六時までに待ちました → 友達を六時まで待ちました, and rewrote the note

issues.problem: rule listed the questions in a different order from the numbered steps in explain
issues.action: Rule order aligned with explain: noun link, topic, addition, object, subject, point, setting, partner or list

issues.problem: 'every other action takes で' is false if applied mechanically (駅に着く, 東京に住む, 椅子に座る take に)
issues.action: Added the verbs of arriving, sitting, living and putting that take に; で limited to actions carried out at a place

issues.problem: 'These words never take を' overstated (〜を好き occurs in real usage)
issues.action: Changed to 'In standard Japanese these words take が, not を'

issues.problem: English of 姉も犬が好きです ('likes dogs too') could be read as dogs in addition to something else, not も on 姉
issues.action: Changed to 'My older sister, too, likes dogs.'

issues.problem: tip 'Likes or has it: が' is misleading because 持つ (have) takes を
issues.action: Changed to 'Likes, can or there is: が'
